profile.headline: Principal Engineer (System & Security SW)
profile.summary:
Software Engineer interested and skilled in Device Security, Embedded systems and SoC having:
•	Security Architecture and Solution on Android/Linux/RTOS-based Devices
•	Bootloaders, Linux BSP Development in Android/Linux/RTOS-based embedded system
•	Software Power Optimization Techniques in Embedded Systems
•	Pre-/Post-Silicon validation in SoC
•	Wireless Communication Protocol (WLAN)

positions.title: Principal Software Engineer (Platform development team, System LSI business)
positions.description:
While working as a principal software engineer, my primary task was to validate the pre- and post-silicons of the Exynos series and develop bootloaders to load Android OS. Now my role is in charge of performance improvement for Android Mobile Devices in the System LSI business division.

[Exynos SoC series for Android-OS based Mobile Devices]
- pre- / post-silicon validation and Implemented Bootloaders (BL1, BL2 and EL3_Mon) and Little Kernel to load Android OS
- Developed Digital Droop-Detection(DDD) and Digital Power Monitor(DPM) solutions to improve performance and optimize power consumption of the Exynos-SoC based Android Mobile Devices.
- Implemented Linux QoS and system monitoring features to improve WiFi performance in the Android-based Mobile Devices.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer (Platform Development Team, System LSI Business)
positions.description:
As a senior software engineer in the platform development team, I was responsible for validating SoCs, porting operating systems, and developing the security features for Exynos SoC series

[Exynos SoC series for Android/RTOS-based devices]
- Ported and implemented OS and developed drivers of internal HW IPs and external peripheral interfaces
- Developed Firmware OTA(Over-The-Air) scheme in the Exynos SoC series
- Implemented Exynos-SSS(Security Sub-System) device driver to enable HW crypto features
- Implemented device driver for RPMC(Replay Protection Monotonic Counter)-enabled flash memory

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer (Security Team, Mobile business & SSIC)
positions.description:
As a senior security engineer, my main task was to make an efficient secure boot chain to guarantee the integrity of system binaries and port secure OS to enable ARM-Trustzone of various SoCs for Samsung's mobile and IoT devices in mobile business and Samsung Strategy and Innovation Center(SSIC).

[Samsung Knox Project on Android Mobile Phone and IoT Module]
- Designed the secure boot chain and implemented verified boot to guarantee the integrity of bootloaders and Operating system.
- Ported Secure OS and implemented SPD (Secure Payload Dispatcher) to enable ARM TrustZone
- Implemented TUI(Trusted User Interface) scheme for payment system
- Implemented SW-PuF Solution to make DUK(Device Unique Key) for Root of Trust of various IoT devices
- Implemented RPMB-based Bootloader Rollback Protection scheme
- Did security hands-on sessions in many countries in Europe and Asia to announce the need a security features of IoT devices in Germany, France, Italy, Singapore, and China.

positions.title: Software Engineer, Core Platform Team
positions.description:
As a Firmware developer in the Core Platform Team, my primary role was to design hardware modules and develop various firmware/bootloader and I2C-based power management drivers including PMICs and battery chargers for various embedded boards.

[IP Telephony Equipment]
- Designed hardware of Voice Conference(VPCM-AD) Module
- Implemented ARIA Crypto Algorithm based on Xilinx FPGA
- Implemented and ported MDTM’s U-boot and Linux Kernel Driver

[The Research of Multimedia Control Point]
- Investigate and study various video codec and advanced technology of Video Conferencing Equipment

[Multimedia Tablet with British Telecom]
- Implemented Power and Battery Manager Daemon and Helper functions to manage power and battery events.
- Did power management and optimization to extend battery life time.
- Ported mainline drivers for IPs like PMIC, charger and USB-hub.

patents.title: System-on-chip including dynamic power monitor and frequency controller and operating method thereof
patents.description: A system-on-chip includes: a dynamic power monitor configured to generate a power detection signal by calculating an amount of power consumed by a functional circuit in real time; a frequency controller configured to detect an idle period and a running period of the functional circuit in response to the power detection signal, and generate a clock control signal based on the power detection signal; and a clock controller configured to change a frequency of a clock signal provided to the functional circuit, based on the clock control signal. The running period includes: a first running period in which the frequency of the clock signal has a first value based on the clock control signal; and a second running period in which the frequency of the clock signal has a second value that is greater than the first value based on the clock control signal.

patents.title: (Internet-of-Things Module) Signing Key Misuse Prevention method and apparatus
patents.description: An Internet of Things module includes a memory including a boot area for storing boot firmware and first security information and a security area for storing a firmware release version and second security information, and a processor to perform a boot process of the Internet of Things module using the boot firmware in the boot area and to determine whether the boot process of the Internet of Things module is progressed or stopped through comparing the first security information in the boot area with the second security information in the security area and through comparing a version of the boot firmware in the boot area with the firmware release version in the security area.
